description: Read your balance of data-exchange tokens: what you hold, what you have earned by contributing price data and what you have spent reading the shared pool. Pass history true to also get the latest token movements, with limit to say how many (up to 100). Free to call. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

history.description: Also return the latest token movements.

limit.description: How many movements to return with history. Defaults to 20.

name: get_jale_token_balance
